_comment: Behaviour the live WordPress site has today, reproduced verbatim, except /checkout/: WooCommerce 302'd it to /cart/ whenever the cart was empty, which with no cart backend was always. The cart now works client-side, so /checkout/ renders the checkout. The three capitalised product-category URLs are internal links that WordPress answers with 200 and a canonical pointing at the lower-case URL, so they are rewritten (not redirected) to keep that exact response.
